setup_batch_predict_server: setup a Ray Serve deployment for batched MLIP inference with configurable batch size and OOM splitting
BatchPredictServer_predict: process a batch of AtomicData objects through an MLIP model with automatic OOM recovery
BatchPredictServer_configure_batching: configure the maximum batch size and wait timeout for the batched prediction server
BatchPredictServer_split_predictions: split batched prediction tensors back into individual per-system prediction dictionaries
BatchPredictServer_get_predict_unit_attr: retrieve an attribute from the underlying MLIP predict unit by name
